_comment: The 48h trade volume below which a book is too thin to trust: its ask is clamped to 1.5x the median, the item reads as thin, and trends are not certified. Read by frontend/src/domain/sell-priority.parity.test.ts and rust/market-math/src/sell_priority.rs. The cases sit on either side of the boundary so a one-sided change of value or of < to <= fails.
